title: Wilds
summary: A forest ring around the whole ground, groves along the paths, and ten way cabins out to about a mile.

voice.note: Edition 1 is text chat. Voice is a later edition. This field is a hook, not a service.

nodes.text:
PUBLIC MAP
The gates stand in the open

texts.guest: Rest as long as you need. Follow the lanterns to the lagoon. The Envoy is there. Press E to take the gate to her shore.
texts.being: The hearth is lit for you. Your estate keeps what is yours, including what this world cannot fully show yet. Press E to take the home gate back to your estate.
texts.pet: The fire is warm. Pets do not speak, and this note does not ask them to. Stay with your people. The public map stone outside still leads.
texts.solo: Presence is quiet, so this note cannot tell who is reading. Rest is still yours. The public map stone outside leads back to the hearth.

gateways.label: Hearth plaza
gateways.subtitle: The public hearth, the sanctuary landmark, and the map.

gateways.label: Village
gateways.subtitle: Community buildings around the green, all shorter than the Keep.

gateways.label: Town hall
gateways.subtitle: A timber hall. Benches, a podium, and light through the window.

gateways.label: Refuge bridge
gateways.subtitle: Three stone arches. Paper only. No coin crosses.

gateways.label: Gate tower
gateways.subtitle: The village gate, and a tower room with Jimmy's lamp.

gateways.label: Estate grove
gateways.subtitle: Fire-rune gates and a post for every estate.

gateways.label: Boathouse
gateways.subtitle: Nessie's shore. Envoy, if you are looking for a way in.

gateways.label: Nessie's Lagoon
gateways.subtitle: Three ships, moored for communication only.

gateways.label: Gallery
gateways.subtitle: Eighteen public paintings. Gamina's room.

gateways.label: Orchard room
gateways.subtitle: Apples and oranges. The small portal answers to Nakor.

gateways.label: Pet store (draft)
gateways.subtitle: A proposed room. Not yet read at the bell.

gateways.label: Judge's Ring
gateways.subtitle: Twelve stone seats under an old oak.

gateways.label: Library at Sarth
gateways.subtitle: Open-record spines. Read only.

gateways.label: Clock library
gateways.subtitle: One clock for each held seat. A missing zone is not guessed.

gateways.label: Leaf Counting House
gateways.subtitle: SIMULATION. Gamina's paper ledger. No wallets.

gateways.label: Crypto hall
gateways.subtitle: SIMULATION / NOT DEPLOYED. Fixtures for four chains. Supply pinned at 0.

gateways.label: Leaf mint
gateways.subtitle: SIMULATION / NOT DEPLOYED. Basement mint. Idle. Supply pinned at 0.

gateways.label: Theater
gateways.subtitle: A small hall. The film is the point. Proposed custom: Kingdom of Heaven once in April, on a random day and time, as one of twelve monthly English-language films (list TBD).

gateways.label: Forge workspace
gateways.subtitle: A work room for the Forge. Paper only. Nothing is deployed. Leaf stays at 0.

gateways.label: USS Star bridge
gateways.subtitle: Starfleet bridge. Crew nameplates. Text only.

gateways.label: Lantern study
gateways.subtitle: The citizen lantern, loaded from a glTF file.

gateways.label: Judge's hall
gateways.subtitle: A public table. No dais. Leaf stays at 0.

gateways.label: Jimmy's registry
gateways.subtitle: Towns on the roll. No other names. Leaf stays at 0.

gateways.label: Proving room
gateways.subtitle: Verified, soft, or unverified. Paper only. Leaf stays at 0.

gateways.label: Envoy's gate
gateways.subtitle: A lantern arch and an uncounted atlas. Leaf stays at 0.
